content5.ptxt: The engine control computer detects the vehicle inclination from the yaw rate sensor signals and uses it for neutral control. If a yaw rate sensor malfunction is detected from a malfunction signal from the brake actuator assembly, the engine control computer stops neutral control as a fail-safe function.
The brake actuator assembly receives the yaw rate sensor signals via CAN communication.
If a CAN communication line malfunction code is output, perform troubleshooting for the CAN communication malfunction first.

item.ptxt: After IG ON
(a). Yaw rate sensor (G sensor) output value remains -1.5G or less or 1.5G or more for 1.2 seconds or more
(b). Yaw rate sensor (G sensor) power supply voltage remains 4.4V or less or 5.6V or more for 1.2 seconds or more
(c). Momentary interruption of yaw rate sensor (G sensor) signal continues 7 times or more
(d). With the vehicle stopped, after the difference between yaw rate sensor (G sensor) GL1 and GL2 becomes 0.6G or more, it does not drop below 0.4G for 60 seconds or more
(e). Yaw rate sensor (G sensor) power supply malfunction signal is received for 10 seconds or more at a vehicle speed of 3km/h or more

item.ptxt: Initializing the learned values clears both the G sensor 0-point learning values and the CVT hydraulic pressure learning values, so when replacing the parts in the table below, perform AT/CVT learned value initialization and be sure to perform both G sensor 0-point learning and CVT hydraulic pressure learning.
Continuously Variable Transaxle
Engine Control Computer
Skid control computer
Oil Pressure Sensor
Yaw Rate Sensor
After performing AT/CVT learned value initialization, be sure to perform G sensor 0-point learning first, and then CVT hydraulic pressure learning.
Be sure to place the vehicle on a level surface and perform 0 point learning.
Do not subject the vehicle to vibration while 0 point learning is in progress.

When replacing the skid control computer or the yaw rate sensor on vehicles with the Intelligent Parking Assist system, be sure to also perform G sensor 0 point writing for the Intelligent Parking Assist system.
